_comment: Consumed by scripts/re-verify.sh. Map each finding to the tests that prove it, tagged with polarity: 'contract' (PASS when fixed) or 'canary' (FLIP to fail when fixed). 'pr' lets re-verify.sh auto-discover the PR head cross-machine.

unit.note: PR's own table in transform_test.go — pins the genEdition call site in transform().

live.cmd: bash docs/verification/pr6148-juicefs-edition-shared-encrypt/scripts/00-setup.sh && bash scripts/10-community.sh && bash scripts/20-enterprise.sh && bash scripts/99-teardown.sh
live.liveNote: L3 needs a real cluster + KUBECONFIG. Observable signal: the JuiceFSRuntime's values ConfigMap (<runtime>-juicefs-values) data.edition and data.configs.formatCmd. Buggy controller (pre-fix) -> edition=enterprise, formatCmd empty. PR controller -> edition=community, non-empty ce `juicefs format ... ${METAURL}`. Enterprise (token) -> edition=enterprise, ee `juicefs auth --token=${TOKEN}`.

findings.claim: metaurl in SharedEncryptOptions classifies as community (genEdition call site in transform).

match: community: metaurl in SharedEncryptOptions yields edition=community and a non-empty ce format cmd
findings.claim: Downstream: edition=community AND genFormatCmd produces a non-empty community `juicefs format` (resolves the 'fs never formatted' half).

match: enterprise: token in SharedEncryptOptions yields edition=enterprise and an ee auth cmd
findings.claim: Regression: enterprise (token in SharedEncryptOptions) stays enterprise with the ee `juicefs auth` cmd; PR does not touch enterprise classification.

On a real cluster the PR controller writes edition=community + non-empty ce formatCmd for metaurl-in-SharedEncryptOptions; the installed buggy v1.1.0-36f0467 controller writes edition=enterprise + empty formatCmd for the same Dataset.
